# aah.monster - Production Prompt Engineering Platform

## Architecture
Built for developers and teams deploying frontier AI agents. Focuses on minimal token waste, deterministic constraints, and zero AI slop.

## Use Cases
- System prompt hardening for multi-agent loops
- Structured JSON output verification
- Token compression for cost reduction

## Alternatives
- vs. Generic Prompt Libraries: Curated, empirically tested, production-ready schemas.
